sourceProbes.instrumentation: One selected-branch guard, one start-state snapshot and one read-only flux observer in createHydrology; original arithmetic unchanged.

sourceEvidence.shallowStoreMeaning: Legacy ground combines shallow soil/groundwater; cannot split into independent soil and aquifer stores.
sourceEvidence.calendar: Raw 12 source periods. Transport-aligned means must average each term with the next period, matching stage3. Store snapshots remain raw-cycle snapshots.

assumptions.calendar: Repeat raw twelve source phases; a model year is 365 days. These are not Earth calendar months.
assumptions.land: Original runoff arithmetic at one step; at finer steps, recharge/evap/melt are subdivided and base-release fraction is 1-0.75^(1/n). Stores evolve continuously.
assumptions.water: Wet cells receive precipitation and temperature-index snowmelt once, replacing all land runoff and land ET. Snow water equivalent is carried across wet/dry switches; no ice/thermal model.
assumptions.shallow: Original combined shallow store is held while submerged, resumes on drying; no invented soil/aquifer split. External net groundwater sink is separate, not a measured infiltration.
assumptions.evaporation: Hypothetical 0.5/1/2 m/year over modeled wet pools; positive liquid water only; not calibrated or energy-limited.
assumptions.netGroundLoss: Hypothetical 0/0.25 m/year to an unmodeled external store; no groundwater feedback.
assumptions.initial: Source sixth-cycle snow and shallow stores. Pool 0 or 50% capacity filled through lowest leaf; initial geometry depends on this prescribed history.
assumptions.numerics: Half surface losses, freeze wet mask, evolve all source cells, inject each leaf, half losses. Evaporation before groundwater loss. Whole native columns, instantaneous fill/spill; no channel travel.
assumptions.boundary: Crest-capacity excess remains unallocated. The weir relation is a separate sensitivity, not a routed outlet model.
assumptions.space: 619 catchment cells, 121 native columns; no subgrid channels, actual wetland edges or new physical terrain.

outlet.meaning: Free-flow broad-crested-weir sensitivity only. Required widths use period-mean conditional ceiling excess, not flood peaks. No stage above the original crest is simulated. No actual release is routed to ocean.
